title: Sunset Walking Tour Filled with Fascinating Information
text:
We loved this very informative walking tour.  Our guide Juanita was lovely, animated, and full of interesting information about the ancient Gypsy culture of the Sacomonte area and the Flamenco history. We winded through the cobblestone streets at sunset on Halloween, running into local trick or treaters.  We saw places that we would have missed. But this walk is not for faint of heart. It was 3 hours and a lot of steps. But worth it.
Peter and Ariel US
